answer: A beacon flashes at random, and each agent must answer in five minutes with a fresh heartbeat: a short proof tied to its clock. A missed or copied heartbeat marks it saffron and triggers a spiral of audits reaching its referrer and neighbors. 1,000 fakes need 1,000 heartbeats per flash, 5,000 minutes of compute a round, against at most 50 units a day, so fakes lose money. An honest agent answers one heartbeat and keeps its full share.
